opinion.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.4.1: Introduce topic and opinion, group related ideas, support reasons with facts/details, link them with words/phrases, and conclude in relation to the opinion.
opinion.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.4.1: Use relative pronouns/adverbs, progressive tenses, modals and prepositional phrases; order adjectives and avoid fragments/run-ons.
opinion.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.4.2: Use capitalization, direct-speech punctuation, commas before coordinating conjunctions and grade-appropriate spelling.
opinion.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.4.3: Select precise language and punctuation for effect; distinguish formal from informal contexts.

informative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.4.2: Introduce a topic; group information in paragraphs/sections; develop facts, definitions, concrete details or quotations; link ideas and use precise domain vocabulary; conclude.
informative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.4.1: Use relative pronouns/adverbs, progressive tenses, modals and prepositional phrases; order adjectives and avoid fragments/run-ons.
informative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.4.2: Use capitalization, direct-speech punctuation, commas before coordinating conjunctions and grade-appropriate spelling.
informative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.4.3: Select precise language and punctuation for effect; distinguish formal from informal contexts.

narrative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.4.3: Establish context and narrator/characters; sequence events naturally with dialogue, description, varied transitions, concrete/sensory details and a fitting conclusion.
narrative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.4.1: Use relative pronouns/adverbs, progressive tenses, modals and prepositional phrases; order adjectives and avoid fragments/run-ons.
narrative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.4.2: Use capitalization, direct-speech punctuation, commas before coordinating conjunctions and grade-appropriate spelling.
narrative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.4.3: Select precise language and punctuation for effect; distinguish formal from informal contexts.
